conversation.text: Hi, I have two things: my AC is blowing warm air and I want to get someone out, and I'd also like to know if joining the maintenance plan would save me money on this.

Comfort Club members get a waived $89 diagnostic fee on all service calls, 15% off all repairs (parts and labor), and priority scheduling ahead of non-members, per the Comfort Club overview (membership/comfort_club_overview.md).
Standard is $189 per year or $16.99 per month, and Plus is $269 per year.

The documents don't say whether these benefits apply to a visit booked on the day of joining, so a team member will confirm that when setting up the membership, and I can't say whether joining would save you money on this visit.
